instructions: The marks are indicated in the right-hand margin.
There are NINE questions in this paper.

sub_questions.text: Explain the differences between NFA and DFA.
Design a DFA which accepts all strings which are ending with 101 over an alphabet {0, 1}.
Obtain the regular expression for the following sets :

subparts.label: i
subparts.text: Set of strings over $\Sigma = \{a, b\}$ with exactly two $a$'s.

subparts.label: ii
subparts.text: Set of all strings over $\Sigma = \{0, 1\}$ which should not contain the substring 101.

subparts.label: iv
subparts.text: Set of strings over $\Sigma = \{a, b, c\}$ with no runs of $a$ which has length greater than three.
